areas.title: Our Legal Practice Areas
areas.body: Comprehensive analysis across 12 major Indian legal document types. Swipe or use controls to explore.

rental-agreement.title: Rental Agreement
rental-agreement.description: Analyze lease terms, rent escalation, security deposit caps, and landlord/tenant notice rules.
rental-agreement.overview: A legally binding agreement granting temporary residential occupancy rights. Essential for preventing unilateral rent hikes, illegal deposit retention, and abrupt eviction notices under Model Tenancy laws.

employment-contract.title: Employment Contract
employment-contract.description: Review probation duration, notice pay in lieu, non-compete validity, IP assignment, and severance.
employment-contract.overview: Defines your working terms, CTC breakdown, IP ownership, and exit conditions. Identifies non-compete clauses that are legally void under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act.

loan-agreement.title: Loan & Debt Agreement
loan-agreement.description: Check floating vs fixed interest rates, EMI penalties, collateral hypothecation, and foreclosure fees.
loan-agreement.overview: Establishes debt repayment schedules and collateral security. Highlights illegal foreclosure fees prohibited by RBI guidelines for individual borrowers.

risks.1: Delayed return of property title deeds

commercial-lease.title: Commercial Lease Agreement
commercial-lease.description: Understand fit-out free periods, Common Area Maintenance (CAM), subletting rights, and GST rules.
commercial-lease.overview: Governs office, retail, or industrial spaces. Analyzes heavy CAM surcharges, fit-out rent waivers, long-term escalation caps, and sub-leasing permissions.

risks.1: Lack of municipal commercial usage approvals

nda.title: Non-Disclosure Agreement
nda.description: Evaluate unilateral vs mutual secrecy, definition of proprietary data, carve-outs, and term limits.
nda.overview: Protects business secrets, source code, and client databases. Ensures clear definition of confidential materials with reasonable survival timeframes.

risks.1: Hidden non-compete clauses embedded in NDA

service-contract.title: Service & Freelance Contract
service-contract.description: Define Scope of Work (SOW), payment milestone triggers, revision limits, and liability caps.
service-contract.overview: Protects independent contractors and agencies. Mandates IP transfer only upon 100% full payment settlement and caps total liability to fees received.

risks.0: Unbounded revision requests without extra pay
risks.1: Client withholding final payment without rejection notice

partnership-deed.title: Partnership & Founder Deed
partnership-deed.description: Vesting schedules, equity allocation, profit sharing ratios, decision deadlock rules, and partner exit.
partnership-deed.overview: Establishes founder equity vesting over 4 years to prevent early exits with full equity, and provides voting deadlock resolution procedures.

risks.0: Immediate 100% upfront equity without vesting cliff
risks.1: Paralyzed bank accounts during founder disputes

sale-deed.title: Property Sale & Conveyance Deed
sale-deed.description: Verify clear legal title warranties, encumbrance certificates, seller indemnity, and possession delivery.
sale-deed.overview: Transfers absolute legal title from seller to buyer. Guarantees property is free from mortgages, litigation, or past municipal tax dues.

power-of-attorney.title: Power of Attorney (PoA)
power-of-attorney.description: Understand Special vs General PoA, NRI consulate attestation, revocability, and sub-registrar registration.
power-of-attorney.overview: Authorizes an agent to act for principal in legal or property matters. Differentiates limited Special PoA from risky blanket General PoA.

risks.0: Executing blanket PoA when only one specific task is required

mou.title: Memorandum of Understanding
mou.description: Differentiate non-binding intent from binding exclusivity, confidentiality, and transition timelines.
mou.overview: Outlines preliminary business collaboration terms. Ensures non-binding intent statements are explicitly separated from binding confidentiality terms.

risks.0: Heavy financial penalty clauses in non-binding MoU

affidavit.title: General Affidavit & Sworn Statement
affidavit.description: Notarization rules, stamp paper denomination, sworn fact verification, and perjury liabilities under BNS/IPC.
affidavit.overview: Sworn written statement of facts verified before a Notary Public. Highlights serious criminal liabilities for false statements under perjury laws.

risks.1: Name spelling mismatches with government ID

vendor-agreement.title: Vendor & Supply Chain Agreement
vendor-agreement.description: SLAs, MSME 45-day payment rules, force majeure conditions, quality inspection, and liquidated damages.
vendor-agreement.overview: Governs supply of goods and raw materials. Enforces statutory 45-day MSME payment rules under Section 15 of MSMED Act 2006.

risks.0: Buyer delaying MSME payments beyond statutory 45-day limit
